data.name: Jugal
data.gender_notes: Jugal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jugal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'yug' which means 'union'. It symbolizes the coming together of two things, two people, or two forces. This name is often given to a child born out of a deep bond between two parents or two siblings. The name Jugal carries the meaning “Union, togetherness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jugal usually hope their child will grow to embody union, togetherness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This act of reunification is celebrated as a symbol of eternal love and devotion.
